content.title: The Madison: Everything You Need To Know About The New Taylor Sheridan Show
content.text: So, you heard there’s a new Taylor Sheridan drama series called The Madison, all episodes now streaming on Paramount+. And you’ve gotten the memo that the show is set in Montana, and stars Michelle Pfeiffer and Kurt Russell. But you still have so many questions – burning questions like, “How can I binge-watch it?” Well, there’s no need to hold your horses any longer. We’ve got everything you need to know about The Madison Season 1 right here, including the release schedule, where to stream it, cast information, and much more. Get Started With Paramount+ Where can I watch The Madison? Paramount+ You can watch The Madison on Paramount+. All episodes are now streaming. See below for the complete streaming info: The Madison Season 1 Premiere date: March 14, 2026 No. of episodes: 6 Streaming: Paramount+ How many episodes are there in The Madison Season 1? There are six episodes in The Madison Season 1. What is The Madison about? The Madison is a heartfelt study of grief and human connection following a New York City family in the Madison River valley of central Montana. A prestige drama with an all-star cast, including Michelle Pfeiffer and Kurt Russell, and cinematography that matches the best on the big screen, The Madison features storytelling unlike anything we’ve seen before from Taylor Sheridan. Is The Madison a Yellowstone spinoff? No, The Madison is not a Yellowstone spinoff. The Madison is an original new drama. The show’s central family, the Clyburns, are not connected to the Duttons, or the Dutton family tree. Who is in The Madison cast? Paramount+ The all-star cast of The Madison is led by Oscar® nominee Michelle Pfeiffer and Golden Globe® nominee Kurt Russell. Though you probably know Pfeiffer from such film roles as Selina Kyle/Catwoman in Batman Returns, Elvira Hancock in 1983’s Scarface, and Velma Von Tussle in 2007’s Hairspray – not to mention her Oscar®-nominated performances in Dangerous Liaisons, The Fabulous Baker Boys, and Love Field – the actress has also made big waves on the small screen. She earned an Emmy® nomination for The Wizard of Lies. And she played Betty Ford in the historical anthology drama series, The First Lady, which premiered on SHOWTIME® in 2022. Russell has forged a career that’s as vast as the Madison River Valley. A screen actor since he was a child, he’s a favorite of fans – and directors. He’s starred in a handful of John Carpenter films, including the 1981 dystopian classic Escape From New York, and the 1979 miniseries Elvis (which rated Russell an Emmy® nomination), and three Quentin Tarantino movies, including 2015’s The Hateful Eight. He earned a Golden Globe® nom for his work in the 1983 docudrama Silkwood, and soared into the Marvel Cinematic Universe as Ego in Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2. The Madison‘s star power doesn’t end with Pfeiffer and Russell. Check out the full announced cast list below, as well as the role that each performer plays in the series. Michelle Pfeiffer as Stacy Clyburn Kurt Russell as Preston Clyburn Patrick J. Adams as Russell McIntosh Elle Chapman as Paige McIntosh Matthew Fox as Paul Clyburn Beau Garrett as Abigail Reese Amiah Miller as Bridgette Reese Ben Schnetzer as Van Davis Kevin Zegers as Cade Harris Rebecca Spence as Liliana Weeks Alaina Pollack as Macy Reese Danielle Vasinova as Kestrel Harris Will Arnett as Dr. Phil Yorn Who is the creative team behind The Madison? Taylor Sheridan is the creator of The Madison. The Madison is executive produced by Sheridan, David C. Glasser, John Linson, Art Linson, Ron Burkle, David Hutkin, Bob Yari, Christina Alexandra Voros, Michael Friedman, Michelle Pfeiffer, Kurt Russell and Keith Cox. Emmy® nominee Christina Alexandra Voros (1883) directs all six episodes of the debut season. An Oscar®-nominated writer (Hell or High Water), Sheridan is the co-creator of the Paramount Network drama series Yellowstone, the creator of the Yellowstone origin stories 1883 and 1923 for Paramount+, and an executive producer of Marshals, the new hit CBS Original drama series from the world of Yellowstone. Beyond Yellowstone Ranch, he’s the creator of Tulsa King and Lioness, the co-creator of Landman and Mayor of Kingstown, and an executive producer of Lawmen: Bass Reeves. Upcoming shows from Taylor Sheridan for Paramount+ include the Tulsa King spinoff Frisco King, and the new Yellowstone series Dutton Ranch. For all things Taylor Sheridan, explore The Taylor Sheridan Collection on Paramount+. Is there an official trailer for The Madison? Yes. There is an official trailer for The Madison. Watch it below.
